verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP is mainly tool and auth infrastructure that you plug into your own agents. The only sign of an assistant inside the product is a chat app at chat.pipedream.com, which users can try with Pipedream MCP tools. That app is presented as a demo and reference build (made with the Vercel AI SDK), not as a full built-in assistant for delegating tasks. Missing for 10: documentation of the chat app as a supported in-product assistant, any description of what tasks it can carry out end-to-end, and independent or hands-on evidence of delegating real work to it.
